milestones.label: Application deadline, Round 2 (University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship)
milestones.source_text: The University of Auckland's doctoral scholarships page (official) lists this as the Round 2 closing date. Round 1 closed on 1 November 2026.

milestones.source_text: The University of Auckland's doctoral scholarships page (official) lists this offer date for Round 2.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Round 3 (University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship)
milestones.source_text: The University of Auckland's doctoral scholarships page (official) lists this as the Round 3 closing date; offers by 1 July 2027.

milestones.label: Application deadline, Round 4 (University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship)
milestones.source_text: The University of Auckland's doctoral scholarships page (official) lists this as the Round 4 closing date; offers by 1 October 2027. One faculty page advises international applicants new to NZ visas to use the earlier rounds.
